prompts.shipyard:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished desktop strategy game UI screenshot, landscape 16:9, full-bleed 1920x1080 composition. This is the P0 ORBITAL SHIPYARD for a Chinese game called 银河帝国. Modern sophisticated space industrial aesthetic inspired by the functional legibility of Dyson Sphere Program and Civilization, with restrained dark graphite (#101619), pale mint (#a4e2cc), warm amber progress, ivory typography. Flat crisp UI with fine borders, almost square corners, spacious but information-dense; no neon overload, no purple, no browser frame, no decoration masquerading as data.
Exact large Chinese headings: 银河帝国, 轨道船坞, 科技树, 新地球, 战斗舰船, 民用舰船, 巡洋舰, 建造队列, 加入建造. Header: small restrained geometric imperial emblem left, navigation tabs 轨道船坞 / 科技树, right three resource counters with compact icons. Left sidebar 260px: 7 ship rows each with a distinct silver spacecraft thumbnail, Chinese ship names 轻型战机, 重型战机, 巡洋舰, 战列舰, 无畏舰, 行星轰炸机, 驱逐舰; selected cruiser row outlined mint. Main center hero: dramatic large hard-surface silver-gray cruiser suspended in a dim orbital drydock, elegant functional silhouette, three-quarter top view, muted distant planet rim and small dock lights, extremely readable ship. Header above hero 巡洋舰 with tiny English CRUISER / C-03. Bottom of hero three slim horizontal comparison bars for firepower armor shield, concise class descriptor. Right 320px production panel: selected ship details with icon-led cost rows 金属 20,000 晶体 7,000 气体 2,000; quantity stepper 1 5 10 最大; total cost, time 00:44, wide mint 加入建造 button. Bottom fixed 155px production dock across center and right: three thumbnail queue cards with counts and one thin amber progress bar, clear first active slot. Footer subtle label 独立设计预览. Chinese legible, typography not tiny. Final image should feel like a coherent finished premium PC game interface, not a website or a poster.
prompts.research:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished Chinese desktop space strategy game TECHNOLOGY TREE interface screenshot, full-bleed landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 composition. Matching 银河帝国 orbital shipyard visual system: restrained dark graphite #101619, desaturated mint #a4e2cc for current and available paths, warm amber for in-progress research, ivory Chinese typography. Crisp matte panels, fine borders, subtle star dust only, no neon overload, no purple. Main title 科技树, top navigation 轨道船坞 / 科技树 (active), resource counters top right, small independent preview label.
Central 75% of screen is a spacious readable directed graph, progressing left to right over 4 labeled columns 基础科学 / 应用科学 / 深空工程 / 战略突破. Each technology node is a compact rectangular tile with a beautiful square illustrated ORIGINAL MOBILE SPACE GAME STYLE icon on left (energy reactor, red laser emitter, blue ion orb, computer matrix, engine flame, armored plate, shield planet, gravitational sphere), Chinese name, level badge, discreet availability marker. Approximately 14 nodes with deliberate orthogonal thin elbow connectors and ample separation, no tangled spaghetti, no fake charts. Use these exact node labels: 能源科技, 激光科技, 离子科技, 等离子科技, 计算机科技, 星际研究网络, 燃烧引擎, 脉冲引擎, 超空间科技, 超空间引擎, 武器科技, 护盾科技, 强度科技, 天体物理科技. Group related chains in rows, one selected route glows mint, researched nodes subdued mint, unavailable nodes charcoal with a padlock. Selected 超空间引擎 tile highlighted with strong outline. An unobtrusive legend explains 已掌握 / 可研究 / 研究中 / 未解锁. Right 320px inspect panel with enlarged engine icon and title 超空间引擎, Lv 5 → 6, short benefit text 舰船速度提升, a small unlocked destroyer image caption 解锁驱逐舰, prerequisite chips and three cost lines, mint 开始研究 button. Bottom left compact zoom control minus 100% plus and fit-to-view icon. Bottom right of canvas a tiny minimap with highlighted viewport. Bottom persistent current-research strip with icon, 激光科技 Lv 6 → 7, amber progress bar 62%, remaining time. Clean Chinese legibility, editorial hierarchy, decision-focused interface. This must look like a well-designed playable technology tree, not a wall of cards.
